scripts.test: yarn test:up && docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.test.yml run --rm backend-test
scripts.test:local: yarn test:up && docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.test.yml run --rm -e SKIP_DB_INIT=1 -e SKIP_SEED=1 backend-test
scripts.test:coverage: yarn test:up && docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.test.yml run --rm backend-test pytest --cov
scripts.test:xgboost:unit: yarn test:up && docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.test.yml run --rm backend-test pytest app/backend/testing/unit/test_xgboost_model_unit.py -v
scripts.lint: yarn test:up && docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.test.yml run --rm backend-test pylint --recursive=y .
scripts.shell: yarn test:up && docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.test.yml run --rm backend-test bash
